name: Meal prep rhythm
summary: Set up a weekly meal-prep rhythm with a menu, a shopping list and a prep day that fits your household.

onboarding.prompt: How many people are you feeding?
Tap your prep and shopping slots.

plan_blueprint.calendar: A shopping slot, a prep day, and cooking nights with that night's meal in the event notes.

approach_variants.habit: Same prep day every week, paired with a favourite playlist; streak of prep days kept.
approach_variants.willpower: Challenge: a full week of home-cooked dinners with a countdown.
approach_variants.time: Menu planning, shopping and prep each get a calendar block; weekly time review.
approach_variants.reward: Owner-chosen non-food treat after each month of prep days.
approach_variants.resource: First week stocks containers, pantry staples and a short list of go-to recipes.

guardrails: Talk to your doctor before starting. GoalKin offers education, not medical advice.
Recipes and menus are suggestions, not medical nutrition advice. For a doctor-advised diet, follow your clinician's guidance.
Product, app or recipe ideas are labeled as suggestions; any affiliate link is disclosed.
Every plan item can be edited, moved or removed, and you can add your own steps.
restart_rules: A missed prep day shifts to an easy-meals week. Missed cooking nights roll to leftovers.
